column1: # Tabell: Utgifter til utdanningsinstitusjoner per heltidsekvivalent elev eller student (Education at a Glance)
# Tall endret: 2026-11-12 (datoen den ukentlige hentingen sist fant endrede tall hos OECD)
# OECD-tittel: Expenditure on educational institutions per full-time equivalent student
# MEASURE (lik for alle rader): FIN_PERSTUD=Expenditure per full-time equivalent student
# Q_SHEET (lik for alle rader): SOURCE=FIN1-SOURCE - Source of expenditure on education
# REF_AREA: DEU=Germany; DNK=Denmark; FIN=Finland; GBR=United Kingdom; ISL=Iceland; NLD=Netherlands; NOR=Norway; OECD=OECD; SWE=Sweden; USA=United States

# EDUCATION_LEV: ISCED11_0=Early childhood education; ISCED11_01=Early childhood educational development; ISCED11_02=Pre-primary education; ISCED11_1=Primary education; ISCED11_1T4=Primary to post-secondary non-tertiary education; ISCED11_1T8=Primary to tertiary education; ISCED11_2=Lower secondary education; ISCED11_24=Lower secondary general education; ISCED11_25=Lower secondary vocational education; ISCED11_2_3=Secondary education; ISCED11_3=Upper secondary education; ISCED11_34=Upper secondary general education; ISCED11_34_44=Upper secondary and post-secondary non-tertiary general programmes; ISCED11_35=Upper secondary vocational education; ISCED11_35_45=Upper secondary and post-secondary non-tertiary vocational programmes; ISCED11_3_4=Upper secondary and post-secondary non-tertiary all programmes; ISCED11_4=Post-secondary non-tertiary education; ISCED11_44=Post-secondary non-tertiary general education; ISCED11_45=Post-secondary non-tertiary vocational education; ISCED11_5=Short-cycle tertiary education; ISCED11_5T8=Tertiary education; ISCED11_6T8=Bachelor's, Master's and Doctoral or equivalent level

# EXP_SOURCE: S13=General government; S14=Households; S1D_NON_EDU=Private sector (households and other non-educational private entities); S1D_NON_EDU_O=Other non-educational private sector; S2=Rest of the world; _T=Total

# EXP_DESTINATION: INST_EDU=All educational institutions; INST_EDU_PRIV=Private educational institutions; INST_EDU_PRIV_GOV=Government dependent private educational institutions; INST_EDU_PRIV_IND=Independent private educational institutions; INST_EDU_PUB=Public educational institutions

# EXPENDITURE_TYPE: ASERV=Expenditure for ancillary services; CORE=Expenditure for core services; DIR_EXP=Expenditure for educational institutions; NORD=Excluding research and development (R&D); RD=Expenditure for R&D in educational institutions
# PRICE_BASE: Q=Constant prices; V=Current prices; _Z=Not applicable
# UNIT_MEASURE: PT_B1GQ_POP=Percentage of GDP per capita; USD_PPP_ST=US dollars per student, PPP converted; XDC_ST=National currency per student
